posts.text: Hot take: Go error messages are better than most documentation. Finally finished repotting 79 tomato seedlings on the bike co-op. Took 81 photos at the old library and exactly one of them is in focus. Packing list for the weekend trip is 47 items long and somehow still missing socks. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 44 pages. Volunteering at the old library this Thursday, come say hi if you are around. My dog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house.
